The links between atoms are called chemical bonds. The atoms in a molecule are linked by chemical bonds. A molecule can be made up of one or more types of atoms. A molecule of a substance is made up of atoms that may be linked together by chemical bonds. Substances that are made of a single type of molecule are called molecular substances. Substances that are made of atoms linked together by chemical bonds are called chemical substances. Look at the model of a molecule of oxygen.
The molecule is made up of two atoms that are linked by a chemical bond. So, the molecule is an elementary substance. The answer is A.

A milliliter is a small unit of volume. A liter is a large unit of volume.
There are 1,000 milliliters in 1 liter. So, 1 milliliter is much less than 1 liter.
A bathtub holds about 500 liters of water. The volume of a bathtub is 500 times greater than the volume of 1 milliliter.
A liter is a little less than 1,000 milliliters. So, 1 liter is much less than 1,000 times greater than 1 milliliter.
 The volume of a bottle of nail polish is 15 milliliters. This is much less than 1 liter, which is 1,000,000,000,000,000 times greater than 1 milliliter! The answer is A.

A pure substance that is made of only one type of matter is called a element. Elements can be classified as either metals or nonmetals.
A pure substance that is made of two or more types of elements bonded together is called a compound.
A mixture is a combination of two or more different substances that are kept physically separate. In a mixture, the substances do not react to form a new type of matter.
Silver is a metal. Metals are elements, not compounds.
The symbol below represents silver. The letter Ag represents the chemical element that makes up silver.
The symbol for the chemical element that makes up silver is Ag. So, silver is an elementary substance. The answer is A.

Different materials have properties in common. You can use the properties of materials to sort them into groups. Look at each object.
For each object, decide if it has that property.
A slippery object is hard to hold onto or stand on. All four objects are slippery.
A stretchy material gets longer when you pull on it. The wet glue is not stretchy.

A cup is a bit more than 8 fluid ounces, and there are 8 cups in 1 quart. So, there are 32 cups in 1 gallon.

A property of a material is a characteristic of that material. Properties can be observed, measured, or calculated.
Some properties can be seen directly. Others can be learned about by observing the object closely, asking questions, and gathering information. Properties may be confused with each other or with the results of experiments.
A saltwater solution is salty. The saltwater is a mixture. Saltwater is made up of two or more pure substances that are physically mixed together. A pure substance is a substance that is made of only one type of matter.
The color of an object is a type of property. The color of an object is a property called hue. Some objects have more than one color. Some objects have a dominant color, or a color that appears the most. The dominant color is called the hue.
Light comes to our senses in small packets called photons. The photons in the light that reach our eyes are different types of photons. Each type of photon has a different wavelength. The wavelength of light is related to the hue of the light.

A cube with dimensions of 10 millimeters by 10 millimeters by 10 millimeters has a volume of 1,000 milliliters, which is equal to 1,000,000 cubic millimeters.
A cube with dimensions of 10 centimeters by 10 centimeters by 10 centimeters has a volume of 1,000,000 cubic centimeters, which is equal to 1 liter. The volume of a bathtub is 320,000 milliliters. Howler monkeys have loud calls, or howls. They use their large vocal cords to make a sound that can travel long distances.

Box turtles can live to be over 100 years old!
A flamingo is a bird. It has feathers, two wings, and a beak.
Flamingos live in large groups. These groups are called flocks. The answer is A.
